name: TimePicker
summary: Pick a time of day from scrolling hour/minute/second columns — schedules, reminders, durations — rendered through the shared TimePicker.
lead: TimePicker carries scrolling hour/minute/second columns, 12/24-hour and locale handling — too much to rebuild as a web component, so it stays on real Ant: antd v6 (React) and ant-design-vue v4 (Vue). It is built on Ant's DatePicker internals, so both wrappers theme once through the shared timePickerTheme. Two implementations, one DS V3 look. This is the composite half of the hybrid.

whenToUse.when: a time of day on its own — a reminder, a daily schedule slot
a date AND a time together — a precise timestamp
a small fixed set of times (e.g. 15-min slots) — a list beats scrolling

opinion.note: Match format to the precision you need — HH:mm hides seconds. Use minuteStep to snap to sensible increments rather than every minute. Times use Day.js.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — antd v6 TimePicker (DatePicker internals) themed by the shared timePickerTheme, no re-implementation. Matrix: size (small 24 / default 32 / large 40) · status (error / warning) · disabled · format (HH:mm / HH:mm:ss / h:mm a via use12Hours) · allowClear · RangePicker (start → end). Field look inherits the DS V3 input treatment (radius 8, 1px #E3E3E3 border, brand #6A1EBB selected cell, error #FF5A7A). Verified via Figma search_design_system against the DS V3 set (fileKey MwjvUjVI0HnfwD9EwPXRAy): no dedicated TimePicker component exists in DS V3 — the DS themes antd rather than redrawing it, so antd v6's TimePicker API is the reference; field styling matches the measured DS V3 input matrix (inp|{sm,md,lg}).

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: Composite has no framework-free element, so its paste-and-run form is a CDN-React page — React + antd load from a CDN and mount on open, consuming the same shared timePickerTheme. No build step.

codeNote: React and Vue are two real vendor libraries at two Ant generations — they can't share a primitive. They converge via the same token/theme (timePickerTheme); residual drift is caught by visual regression. Both use Day.js for times.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Composite shown as a CDN-React page mounted at #react-root; the measure reads the real antd v6 TimePicker (DatePicker internals) bound to timePickerTheme.
